ValidationRule.description: Vat number must be >4 and <20 characters long
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( $User.Alias <> "sconn",
$RecordType.Name = "SAP Germany",
ISPICKVAL(Account_Group__c , "QioDebitoren Europäische Union - DEEU"),
OR( LEN(VAT_Registration_Number__c) <= 8, LEN(VAT_Registration_Number__c) >= 14 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: VAT Number can not be blank and must be 4 to 20 characters long.
